summary: Initial content creation for Cursor's pricing page

change_summary.what_changed: Initial content creation for Cursor's pricing page
specific_changes: Introduction of pricing plans (Hobby, Pro, Ultra, Teams, Enterprise)
Description of features included in each plan
Mention of supported models and custom models
Information on code ownership and privacy
Details on plan limits and usage
Introduction of the Cursor Tab feature
Call to action for contacting sales and joining the forum

strategic_analysis.business_impact: The introduction of pricing plans and features suggests Cursor is transitioning from a free or beta service to a commercial offering, which could significantly impact revenue and user adoption.
market_signals: Cursor is targeting individual developers and teams with its pricing plans
The company is emphasizing the value of its custom models and supported models
Cursor is highlighting its focus on code ownership and privacy
strategic_analysis.competitive_implications: Cursor's pricing and feature set may be competitive with other AI-powered code editors and development tools, potentially disrupting the market and attracting users from established players.
strategic_analysis.strategic_direction: Cursor appears to be focusing on commercialization and expansion, with a emphasis on providing value to individual developers and teams through its pricing plans and features.
